decision: Promote corrected-label v2 for the assisted prototype; retain v1 checkpoint and all historical evidence.
evaluation: Both checkpoints evaluated on the same 62 held-out source images with corrected v2 rodent labels; images were not added to training. This is not comparable to the old evaluation against defective source boxes.
annotation_limit: Visible-landmark envelopes with padding can describe a head or other visible part, not necessarily the full animal. Only 20 rodent test images; ground truth is not independently human-certified.
tradeoffs: Animal localization and aggregate AP improved under corrected labels; the test set is small and is not a deployment guarantee.
Water AP50 decreased from 0.164462 to 0.140917, although water recall increased; water remains a substantial weakness.
At confidence 0.35, exploratory global TP/FN counts remain 26/307; class redistribution and fewer false positives do not mean all misses are solved.
The Queens litter image regressed from one true detection to none. The New Orleans litter image retains three visibly correct markings.
Close rat is now marked in every frame of an adaptation-source clip; this is training-source regression consistency, not independent precision.
Rat near refuse remains missed; the giant false rat over the roof tile disappeared. The obscured vegetation clip is still unmarked.
hardware_note: Baseline metrics used CPU and candidate used RTX 4060; no latency speedup ratio is claimed between these runs.
